system_map.overview: CAS Runner implements a continuous architecture and governance engine that verifies, calculates, and evolves architectural decisions across workspace files, git deltas, and declarative knowledge repositories.

layers.name: presentation
layers.purpose: CLI interface and command execution entrypoint.

layers.name: application
layers.purpose: Execution flow orchestration, governance action service dispatch, and lifecycle bootstrapping.

layers.name: domain
layers.purpose: Core business models, transition registries, compliance engines, and health evaluation metrics.

layers.name: infrastructure
layers.purpose: I/O abstractions, external model providers, and mock environments.

components.name: FlowRunner
components.role: Orchestrates step execution across governance assessment and steering synchronization.

components.name: GovernanceActionEngine
components.role: Manages state transitions and governance decisions through a registered transition map.

components.name: ComplianceEngine
components.role: Evaluates architectural rules and generates compliance findings.

components.name: HealthModel
components.role: Pure functional calculation of system status, health scores, and underlying failure reasons.

patterns.name: Pydantic Domain Entity Modeling
patterns.summary: Encapsulation of architectural facts, metrics, and governance entities into strongly typed, declarative Pydantic schemas.
patterns.intent: Ensure immutable contracts and schema validation at runtime boundaries for all architectural governance entities.
patterns.context: The system processes structured governance artifacts, deltas, and compliance checks from file repositories and external tools.
forces: Complex rule contexts with varying schema versions.
Need for strict serialization to and from JSON/YAML.
Prevention of malformed runtime telemetry or metrics.
patterns.solution: Define domain structures as Pydantic models with explicit field validations, allowing seamless conversion between disk representations and runtime data.
implementation_signals: Inheritance from BaseModel or Pydantic dataclasses
Definitions of GovernanceInventory, ComplianceMetrics, and SteeringRuntimeIndex

evidence.note: Defines rich data structures for tracking governance metrics and findings.
Models version control changes and steering capability lineage.

benefits: Self-documenting domain structures with auto-generated OpenAPI/JSONSchema support.
costs: Model instantiation overhead during high-volume data ingest.
failure_modes: ValidationError exceptions raised uncaught during batch processing.

patterns.name: Transition Registry State Machine
patterns.summary: Registry-based state transition mapping that decouples governance action execution from state machine definitions.
patterns.intent: Provide a centralized, pluggable table of permissible governance state transitions to control artifact promotion.
patterns.context: Architectural artifacts (proposals, rules, decisions) transition across statuses (draft, approved, rejected, retired) via governance actions.
forces: Hardcoding transitions in conditionals causes branching complexity.
New governance lifecycles need to be introduced without modifying existing execution code.
patterns.solution: Use a TransitionRegistry to declare legal transitions and pass state machines to a GovernanceActionEngine for dispatching actions.
implementation_signals: TransitionRegistry class holding state keys and valid target states

evidence.note: Separates state transition rules from action execution.

benefits: Enforces deterministic state flow for architectural artifacts.
Simplifies adding custom transition interceptors and validations.
costs: Requires upfront configuration of all legal state paths.
failure_modes: Unregistered states cause abrupt runtime transition rejections.

patterns.name: Application Service Facade
patterns.summary: Encapsulation of governance workflows behind a single coarse-grained service interface.
patterns.intent: Provide entrypoints like CLI and external automation with a clean, cohesive boundary to complex governance engines.
patterns.context: The CLI and workflows need to execute complex multi-step operations (e.g. evaluating compliance, updating registers, and calculating health).
forces: Presentation layer must not leak knowledge of engines or transition registries.
patterns.solution: Expose GovernanceActionService as an orchestration facade coordinating the GovernanceActionEngine, ComplianceEngine, and storage layers.
implementation_signals: Service class aggregating multiple domain engines
High-level verb methods (e.g., execute, reconcile, apply)

evidence.note: Coordinates governance action execution across engines.

benefits: Prevents presentation components from depending on deep internal mechanisms.
Centralizes transaction boundaries and error logging.
costs: Can evolve into a 'God Object' if too many disparate domain actions are combined.
failure_modes: Service methods obscuring granular failure statuses from underlying engines.

patterns.name: Pure Health Evaluation Pipeline
patterns.summary: Isolating health score computations and diagnosis reasoning into pure, side-effect-free evaluation functions.
patterns.intent: Decouple metric aggregation and health classification from I/O and state storage.
patterns.context: Dashboards and CI jobs need to determine workspace architectural health from runtime inventories without mutating workspace files.
forces: Health checks must run quickly and deterministically across different execution contexts.
Testing health calculations should not require mocking filesystem or network calls.
patterns.solution: Provide isolated functions (e.g. calculate_health, get_health_reasons) operating on immutable health status definitions.
implementation_signals: Pure functions accepting domain snapshots and returning enum statuses or strings
Separation of calculation logic from dashboard rendering

evidence.note: Implements deterministic health calculation and diagnosis without I/O dependencies.

benefits: Easy to reuse across CLI diagnostics, dashboard UI, and CI gates.
costs: Data preparation must occur prior to invoking the evaluation functions.
failure_modes: Incomplete input data leading to false-positive health status degradation.

patterns.name: Hierarchical File-Backed Knowledge Store
patterns.summary: Directory-level separation of global governance, project-specific overrides, runtime artifacts, and templates directly in the Git tree.
patterns.intent: Treat architectural knowledge and governance policies as version-controlled code artifacts without an external database.
patterns.context: Continuous architecture governance relies on versioned decisions, rules, and metrics distributed across projects.
forces: Need version control, diffing, and PR-based approvals for architectural governance.
Global organizational policies must coexist with project-level exceptions and runtime traces.
patterns.solution: Organize knowledge assets into a structured filesystem hierarchy under cas-knowledge/{global,projects,runtime,templates}/.
implementation_signals: Directory structures for global/ vs projects/ vs runtime/
YAML/JSON configuration and Markdown template trees

evidence.note: Holds organization-wide decisions, governance, models, patterns, rules, and signals.
Holds project-level contextual models and architectural assertions.
Maintains execution profiles, evaluations, and runtime traces.

benefits: Zero external database dependency for policy persistence.
costs: File contention during high-frequency concurrent writes.
Slower query performance compared to indexing databases.
failure_modes: Orphaned or malformed Markdown/YAML files breaking schema ingestion.

patterns.name: Pluggable Infrastructure Client Adapter
patterns.summary: Adapter pattern isolating external provider implementations behind uniform client contracts.
patterns.intent: Decouple external provider calls from business execution and allow seamless test stubbing.
patterns.context: The system communicates with external model APIs but requires hermetic offline runs for local tests and CI validation.
forces: Third-party API dependencies introduce network flakiness and cost during test runs.
Runtime configuration must switch between mock and real execution transparently.
patterns.solution: Implement a common client interface realized by production adapters (LiteLLMClient) and offline adapters (MockLLMClient).
implementation_signals: Parallel client classes sharing method signatures
Dedicated mock client implementation in the llm/ directory

evidence.note: In-memory test double mimicking client behavior without external network access.

benefits: Enables zero-dependency local testing and CI pipeline validation.
Encapsulates provider SDK changes within a single module.
costs: Mock clients can drift from real API behavior if not continuously validated.
failure_modes: Subtle behavioral differences between mock responses and real network payloads.

patterns.name: Workspace Bootstrap Merger
patterns.summary: Programmatic initialization and governance block injection for managed workspaces.
patterns.intent: Ensure target projects have valid governance definitions merged into their repository configurations before runner execution.
patterns.context: Repositories onboarding to CAS require a standardized governance harness and directory structure.
forces: Manual repository setup leads to omitted governance markers.
Overwriting existing user configuration causes data loss.
patterns.solution: Implement dedicated bootstrap procedures that selectively inject and merge governance blocks into project configuration files.
implementation_signals: Safe template copy and YAML/JSON block merge routines

evidence.note: Handles safe project onboarding and governance structure initialization.

benefits: Uniform workspace baseline across disparate repositories.
costs: Must handle diverse repository layouts and edge cases during merging.
failure_modes: Corrupting target workspace configuration when encountering unconventional formats.

anti_patterns.name: Unbounded File-System State Synchronization
symptoms: Direct disk read/write operations without explicit file locking or transactional rollbacks.
Concurrency conflicts when multiple CI runners or agents modify the same cas-knowledge workspace simultaneously.
impact: Potential partial writes leading to corrupt YAML/JSON files and failed compliance parsing.
suggested_remediation: Introduce an atomic file writing pattern (write to temporary file, then atomic rename) and implement lockfiles for knowledge mutation routines.

anti_patterns.name: Agentic Domain Term Bleeding into Structural Engine
symptoms: Domain and governance orchestration classes named directly after AI concepts (e.g. AgenticMerger in governance module) instead of structural business concepts.
impact: Blurring the boundary between deterministic governance verification and non-deterministic agentic reasoning.
suggested_remediation: Isolate LLM/agentic merging behind a strategy interface such that the core governance engine only interacts with deterministic merge abstractions.

cross_cutting_concerns.name: Observability & Tracing
cross_cutting_concerns.description: Integration of OpenTelemetry (opentelemetry-api, opentelemetry-sdk) for instrumentation across execution flows.

cross_cutting_concerns.name: Schema Validation
cross_cutting_concerns.description: Cross-boundary data validation using Pydantic and JSONSchema to ensure structural correctness of on-disk configurations and runtime indexes.

open_questions.context: Both GitHub actions manipulate files in cas-knowledge/ without apparent distributed locking.
